test_title: PYST 35: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, 'BURPS' is written as ‘DXVUY’ and ‘TARDEN’ is written as ‘VDVIKU’. How will 'GUARD’' be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9f2222d13f0d75477f5789fe34c986626f9d54f937ee85ec5f0db5452d8cd8.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

'BURPS' is written as ‘DXVUY’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f40504b81fd0ddd7d0c979558cf7a2b74a6c9108628e149a2f024ffa60a0501.png] 

‘TARDEN’ is written as ‘VDVIKU’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1f24262d6bf100e2f4d4f958cc3a4ed7055e4236ecf0118687babef4d769006.png] 

Similarly, 'GUARD’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eef4f49befad1922bfd25d9a557c36aeb51c455c4956ae734f91afe3b7744ba7.png] 

Hence, **'option 2'** is the correct answer.
